messages:
jordan: heads up — seeing deterministic drift in completions after coldstart on magnet-l12q int4v2. long-prefix prompts diverge after ~6k tokens, different runs produce different tails. anyone seen this?
maya: is that int4v1 or int4v2 config?
jordan: int4v2. config used: `quant_bits=4, per_channel=true, symmetric=false`
benji: can you paste a minimal repro prompt + logs? any `kv_index_mismatch` or handshake warnings?
jordan: minimal prompt attached (shortened): 'System: you are an archivist. Provide a detailed multi-part timeline with citations...' logs snippet: ```
[2026-03-20T14:02:12Z] model=magnet-l12q quant=int4v2 seq=6139 kv_index_mismatch expected=6138 observed=6139
[2026-03-20T14:02:12Z] rot_scale=1.000000
[2026-03-20T14:02:12Z] WARNING: prefix_cache_flush after coldstart
```
cara: fwiw I reproduced something similar on dedicated yesterday — it only showed up if a prefill+flush happens during warmup. thinking handshake across shard boundaries + rope wrap. did you try disabling kv cache?
jordan: tried `REDWOOD_KV_CACHE=0` — reduced severity but divergence still appears on some seeds. repro cmd: `./tools/bench/run_longctx.sh --model magnet-l12q --quant int4v2 --prompt samples/long_prefix.txt --seed 42 --no-cache`
maya: sounds like RoPE scaling issues at high positions. do you observe rot_scale drifting between warmstarts? sequence where it breaks?
jordan: divergence window varies 6144-8192 depending on seed. some runs show `rot_scale` toggling between `1.0` and `0.999847` after coldstart.
benji: please run with `ROPE_DEBUG=1` and capture `rot_scale` and kv_index outputs, I'll try to reproduce on orion and check kernel selection differences. also try `--seq-limit 16384` to force longer buffer.
jordan: running now with `ROPE_DEBUG=1`, `--seq-limit 16384`. will paste logs.
triage-bot: created issue HW-4721: "magnet-l12q int4v2 coldstart long-prefix divergence" https://redwood/issue/HW-4721
jordan: assigning to @benji @maya — thanks, will post the debug dump once finished :thumbsup:
